Meta.title: FilesDrop — drop a file, get a link
Meta.description: Share a file without an account. Drop it, copy the link, and it disappears in 1 to 24 hours.

Shell.footer: No sign-up. Files always land on their feet.

Home.title: Drop a file, get a link.
Home.tagline: No account, no fuss. The link lives for up to a day, then the cat knocks it off the table.
Home.dropHint: Drop, paste or click to choose
Home.dropLimits: Up to 95 MB. Gone in 1, 12 or 24 hours.

Drop.zoneLabel: Choose files to upload, or drop them here
Drop.dragSub: Paws up and ready to catch.
Drop.fetchingSub: Chasing the link. Big files take a moment.
Drop.deletedSub: The file is gone for good.
Drop.urlLabel: Or paste a link to a file

Errors.tooBig: This file is too chonky (max 95 MB).
Errors.boxFull: The box is full right now. Try again once some files expire.
Errors.denied: Programs and scripts are not allowed. Zip it or pick another file.
Errors.rateLimited: That's a lot of files at once. Give it a few minutes.
Errors.offline: You're offline. Reconnect and try again.
Errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.invalidUrl: That doesn't look like an http or https link.
Errors.blockedAddress: That address is private or local, so it can't be fetched.
Errors.dnsFailed: That site's name doesn't resolve. Check the link.
Errors.tooManyRedirects: The link redirects too many times.
Errors.remoteStatus: The site answered with an error instead of a file.
Errors.timeout: The site took longer than 30 seconds. Try again or download it yourself.
Errors.notFound: Nyot found — this one ran away.
Errors.wrongToken: This browser doesn't have the key to delete that file.

Result.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
Result.copiedDirect: The direct link opens the file itself.
Result.copiedPreview: The preview link opens a page with the file.

History.title: Your uploads
History.emptyCat: The cat sits in an empty box
History.emptyBody: Files you upload in this browser show up here, with their links and the time they have left.
History.clearBody: {count, plural, one {# entry will be forgotten} other {# entries will be forgotten}} in this browser. The files stay online until they expire, but you won't be able to delete them early.

Preview.ogDescription: {size}, shared with FilesDrop. The link disappears within a day.
Preview.notFoundTitle: Nyot found — this one ran away
Preview.notFoundBody: There's no file at this link. Check it, or ask for a new one.
Preview.expiredTitle: This one's nine lives are up
Preview.expiredBody: The file expired and was deleted. Ask the sender to drop it again.
Preview.unavailableBody: We couldn't load this file right now. Refresh in a moment.
